title: CLI Model Serving
summary: This module provides a command-line interface (CLI) for serving Hugging Face models via an asynchronous web server. It supports various model types and inference optimizations like continuous batching and quantization.

nodes.label: External API Client
nodes.title: User/Application Client
nodes.description: An external system or user that sends HTTP requests to the model serving API endpoints.

nodes.label: Run ASGI Web Server
nodes.title: Uvicorn Web Server
nodes.description: An asynchronous web server (Uvicorn) responsible for listening to incoming HTTP requests and dispatching them to the application handlers.

nodes.label: Start Serving CLI
nodes.title: CLI Entry Point
nodes.description: The command-line interface for initiating the model serving process, allowing configuration of models, server, and inference parameters.

nodes.label: Load & Manage Models
nodes.title: Model Lifecycle Management
nodes.description: Component responsible for dynamically loading, caching, and unloading Hugging Face models based on demand, device, and specified configurations.

nodes.label: Manage Generation Settings

nodes.description: Manages and applies various generation parameters, including continuous batching settings, `torch.compile` status, and other inference optimizations.

nodes.label: Handle Chat API Requests
nodes.title: Chat Completion API
nodes.description: Processes API requests specifically for chat-based text generation, interacting with loaded models and generation settings to produce conversational responses.

nodes.label: Handle Text API Requests
nodes.title: Text Completion API
nodes.description: Processes API requests for general text completion tasks, utilizing managed models and generation configurations to generate free-form text.

nodes.label: Handle Response API Requests
nodes.title: General Response API
nodes.description: Processes API requests for diverse response generation tasks, leveraging the model manager and generation state for model inference.

nodes.label: Handle Audio API Requests
nodes.title: Audio Transcription API
nodes.description: Processes API requests for audio transcription, converting spoken language into text using appropriate models managed by the system.

nodes.label: Hugging Face Models

nodes.label: Continuous Batching Parameters
nodes.title: Batching Optimization
nodes.description: Specific configuration parameters for continuous batching, such as KV cache block size, number of blocks, maximum batch tokens, and GPU memory limits.

nodes.label: Model Quantization Options
nodes.title: Quantization Settings
nodes.description: Configuration for applying quantization techniques (e.g., 4-bit, 8-bit) to models to reduce memory usage and potentially speed up inference.
